title: Hope needs no attractive pretence

captions.physics: Considering the actual consequences of support

meaning: Your care can remain honest and hopeful even when a familiar expectation collapses and earlier support needs reconsidering.
text: Hope may be needed precisely when an attractive expectation fails to withstand reality. In the physical position of Anahata, Justice expresses care through honest actions and attention to the consequences of promises. The Star in energy brings a wish to remain open and avoid closing a good possibility because of disappointment. The Tower in emotions offers shock at a collapsed certainty. You may want to support each other without finding the familiar reassuring words. Warmth here involves real participation that does not insist on calling an unwelcome event a blessing.

For example, a shared piece of work proves unsuitable for the gift you planned because the material behaved differently from what you expected. You decide honestly what can still be repaired today and drop excessive promises. **Hope can remain beside acknowledged disappointment.** A simpler alternative gift need not immediately feel just as pleasing; care means nobody is left alone with the tasks and frustration.

A wish to encourage can dismiss shock by claiming everything must be for the best. Someone then has to hide frustration to preserve a bright shared outlook. Yet a collapsed expectation does not make every earlier contribution false either. Closeness benefits from an honest measure of today: what happened, which help you can genuinely offer and what does not yet need a happy explanation.
